matched_queries: An employer's written policy for allocating staff tips, gratuities and service charges. Consulting workers about the tipping policy, reviewing it, and collecting anonymous worker feedback on tipping arrangements.

Discover UK guidance connected to employers' tipping policies, consultation with workers, policy reviews and worker feedback. Keep a connection to staff tips separate from tax treatment and from an assessment that wording must change.

passages.quote:
The Employment (Allocation of Tips) Act 2023 makes it mandatory for all tips to be passed on to workers without deductions.

This statutory code of practice provides guidance to employers and workers in tipping industries on the fair and transparent allocation and distribution of tips, gratuities and service charges.

Under the act, workers are able to enforce their rights through the employment tribunal system, where judges have a duty, where relevant, to take the code into account.

This came into force on Tuesday 1 October 2024.

You can also read our non-statutory guidance for employers on distributing tips fairly.
